landing.hero_title: Turn your skills and experience into local earnings.
landing.hero_desc: SilverHands is a secure community platform that empowers senior citizens and homemakers to offer services like home cooking, gardening, child tutoring, and tech help to trusted neighbors nearby. Built with safety and dignity at its heart.
landing.verified_members: ⭐ 500+ verified members earning in your neighborhood.
landing.how_it_works_desc: We have simplified every step of the process to ensure seniors can navigate the platform with ease.
landing.seniors_desc: Supplement your pension, share a lifetime of practical wisdom, and stay active in your local neighborhood on your own flexible schedule.
landing.homemakers_desc: Earn independent income using your daily skills like custom culinary baking, hand-crafts sewing, child-minding, and home care.
landing.community_support_desc: Connecting decades of home wisdom and practical skills directly with nearby neighbors who need them.
landing.step1_desc: Register securely with just your phone number. No complex accounts needed.
landing.step2_desc: Simply chat with our friendly AI assistant to list your skills and services automatically.
landing.step3_desc: Receive service requests from verified locals within walking distance.
landing.step4_desc: Deliver help locally, receive praise, and get secure digital payments.
landing.copyright: SilverHands Platform. All rights reserved. Made with love for seniors and homemakers.

tips.tip1_text: When arranging the first job matching consultation, meet in a public location like a neighborhood cafe or apartment clubhouse.
tips.tip2_text: Never send payments or advance cash deposits before any work starts. Always inspect completed tasks before releasing gig earnings.
tips.tip3_text: Always inform a family member, neighbor, or friend about the gig location and expected timings before starting home visits.
tips.tip4_text: Keep messages inside SilverHands. This allows our AI safety tools to protect you from payment scams and verify credentials.
